lines.trans: Everything in the world always changes.

words.gram: nominative neuter singular, used as a noun

lines.trans: New cities are built and grow.
Millions of new people are born.
In our kitchen the day begins the same way.
Vitya, when will you make the new menu?
You promised me a new summer menu.

words.gloss: to me (мне некогда = I have no time)

lines.trans: What summer menu, Vika?

words.gram: short for Виктория, used as address

lines.trans: Why do people need new dishes in summer?
Hello to everyone in our kitchen!
Viktoria Sergeyevna, I did not notice right away.
The chef has been promising a menu for two months already.
After all, summer will end soon.
What a sly chef we have!
Everything in the world always changes.

See you tomorrow!

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

examples.text: Осталось ровно три минуты до готовности блюда.
examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Adds a reason or an obvious truth.

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.
examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: after a plural noun or pronoun: вы все

examples.text: И знаешь, что самое главное? Всем всё равно.
examples.trans: And you know the main thing? Nobody cares.
She's offended. She's always like that.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: The thing that ends is the subject.
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.text: Всё, выборы закончились. Тебя начальник ждёт.
examples.trans: That's it, the election is over. Your boss is waiting for you.
He did not notice the loss.

examples.text: Никто на кухне ничего не заметил.
examples.trans: Nobody in the kitchen noticed anything.
And what if someone notices me?
Oh, Samson. What have you come for?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.
The summer cafe there is still open.

examples.text: Да, там летнее кафе ещё работает.
examples.trans: Yes, the summer cafe there is still open.
Summer will be over soon, after all.
Why do people need new dishes in summer?

examples.text: Этим летом мы поедем на море.
examples.trans: This summer we're going to the seaside.
Why do people need new dishes in summer?
It's very hot here in summer.

meanings.note: on a phone or in a restaurant; indeclinable

examples.text: Что за меню здесь? Как позвонить?
examples.trans: What's this menu here? How do I make a call?

examples.text: Да, люди вокруг меняются к лучшему.
examples.trans: Yes, people around are changing for the better.

meanings.note: Уже месяц = for a month now.

examples.trans: I've been living here for a month.
The election is in a month.

examples.text: Мы с Пашей вместе уже месяц.
examples.trans: Pasha and I have been together for a month now.

meanings.note: after numbers: два миллиона, пять миллионов

examples.text: Значит, предложение такое. Ты мне говоришь, где твои сорок миллионов.
examples.trans: So, here's the offer. You tell me where your forty million is.

meanings.note: The end of a quarrel or war.
the plural is used only in this sense

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Спасибо, теперь для нас начинается новая жизнь.
examples.trans: Thank you, now a new life begins for us.
Our work is only just beginning.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.

meanings.note: + dative of the person: обещать вам

examples.text: Марина, я вам обещаю: со стеной ничего не случится.
examples.trans: Marina, I promise you: nothing will happen to the wall.

examples.text: Как говорил один мудрец, солнце светит всем одинаково.
examples.trans: As a wise man once said, the sun shines equally on everyone.

examples.text: Ты одинаково любишь морепродукты и мясо.
examples.trans: You love seafood and meat equally.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: to grow, to grow up, to develop

examples.text: Вообще надо расти во всех смыслах.
examples.trans: In general, I need to grow in every sense.
Millions of new people are born.

examples.text: У нас рождается новая молодая и красивая семья!
examples.trans: A new, young and beautiful family is being born here!
The baby just doesn't want to be born.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.
You can see it at once.
Now there's a businesswoman, you can see it at once.

строиться.gloss: to be built; to line up

meanings.en: to be built, to be under construction
to line up, to form ranks

examples.trans: New cities are being built and are growing.

examples.text: Рядом с нами строится новый дом.
examples.trans: A new building is going up next to us.

related.gloss: to line up; to be built (pf)

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
Be careful, he is very cunning.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
